metadata.title: Zephyr Protocol Security Audit Checklist - Batch 6
metadata.description: Partial checklist covering properties PROP-111 through PROP-147 plus early PROP-SUB subsystem properties

checklist.title: TransferRootUpdated Event Emission on Storage

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-ROOT-STORED emits TransferRootUpdated event atomically with storage operation.
steps: Locate root storage function in Hub contract
Verify TransferRootUpdated event is emitted after storage update
Check event parameters include correct root value and index
Verify no execution path stores root without emitting event
Test via transaction log verification

executable_checks.focus: Event emission co-located with storage operation

executable_checks.description: Verify event emission via transaction receipts
executable_checks.focus: Event logs contain correct root and index

checklist.notes: Event emission is atomic with storage - standard Solidity guarantee on successful execution

checklist.title: Broadcast Waiting State Transition

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-AWAITING-BROADCAST transitions to broadcast-ready state without automatic broadcast on root update.
steps: Trace updateTransferRoot function execution
Verify no automatic broadcast call after root update
Confirm state waits for explicit broadcast trigger
Check separation between update and broadcast functions
Verify no callback or hook triggers automatic broadcast

executable_checks.focus: Separation of update and broadcast operations
No internal calls from update to broadcast

checklist.notes: Explicit broadcast trigger required - root updates and broadcasts are separate operations

checklist.title: Broadcast Uses Current Root Data

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-BROADCAST-TRIGGERED reads current transferRoots storage at call time for fresh aggregation.
steps: Locate broadcast function in Hub contract
Verify roots are read from storage at call time
Check no caching of root values between calls
Verify aggregation uses freshly fetched roots
Test concurrent update and broadcast scenarios

executable_checks.description: Test broadcast after concurrent root updates
executable_checks.focus: Verify broadcast uses latest root values

checklist.notes: Real-time aggregation computation ensures fresh data usage

checklist.title: PoseidonT3 Tree Root Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-AGGREGATION-COMPUTED produces correct PoseidonT3 tree root matching circom configuration.
steps: Locate aggregation tree computation in Hub
Verify PoseidonT3 implementation matches circom parameters
Check leaf ordering and tree construction
Verify output matches reference implementation for test vectors
Test determinism - same inputs always produce same output

executable_checks.description: Compare aggregation output with circom reference

checklist.notes: Deterministic cryptographic computation - PoseidonT3 collision resistance provides security

checklist.title: Aggregation Sequence Monotonicity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-AGG-SEQ-INCREMENTED advances sequence counter monotonically with no decrement operation.
steps: Locate aggregation sequence counter in Hub
Verify increment operation uses unchecked arithmetic
Check no decrement or reset function exists
Verify counter is incremented on every broadcast
Test overflow behavior at 2^256 boundary

executable_checks.focus: No decrement or reset operations for sequence

checklist.notes: Monotonic counter for ordering - overflow at 2^256 is acceptable and expected

checklist.title: Global Root Storage with Hub EID Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED stores global root only after Hub EID validation with event emission.
steps: Locate global root saving function in Verifier
Verify Hub EID validation is prerequisite to storage
Check storage and event emission are atomic
Verify no path stores root without EID validation
Test rejection of roots from unauthorized EIDs

executable_checks.description: Test rejection of roots from non-Hub EIDs
executable_checks.focus: Only Hub EID can update global roots

checklist.notes: Validated global root storage - Hub EID validation is critical for cross-chain security

checklist.title: Local Stealth Address Generation Privacy

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH is entirely client-side with no network communication during generation.
steps: Review stealth generation implementation in client code
Verify no network calls during generation process
Check all cryptographic operations are local
Verify private key material never leaves client
Test generation works in offline mode

executable_checks.description: Test stealth generation with network disabled

checklist.notes: Local cryptographic operation - no external party should see private information

checklist.title: Stealth Address PoW Validity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-STEALTH-GENERATED produces valid stealth address with PoW nonce search completion.
steps: Locate PoW nonce search in stealth generation
Verify generation only completes with valid nonce
Check PoW constraint is properly enforced
Verify on-chain validation matches client-side constraint
Test invalid PoW rejection on-chain

executable_checks.description: Test PoW validation with invalid nonces

checklist.notes: PoW constraint satisfaction ensures address validity - search continues until valid nonce found

checklist.title: Nova IVC Proof Generation Soundness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATED produces valid IVC proof with local verification catching errors.
steps: Review Nova circuit and witness generation
Verify circuit requires valid witnesses only
Check local verification is performed before output
Verify proof matches user's historical burn records
Test invalid witness rejection during generation

executable_checks.focus: Nova circuit soundness and local verification

executable_checks.description: Test proof generation with invalid witnesses

checklist.notes: Nova IVC soundness - invalid inputs fail circuit satisfaction, local verification catches errors

checklist.title: Job Queue After IVC Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-JOB-QUEUED creates conversion job only after successful IVC validation.
steps: Locate job creation in prover service
Verify IVC validation occurs before queueing
Check no path creates job without validation
Verify invalid IVC proofs are rejected
Test rejection of malformed IVC submissions

executable_checks.description: Test job creation with invalid IVC
executable_checks.focus: Invalid IVC proofs are rejected before queueing

checklist.notes: Validated input before queueing prevents processing of invalid proofs

checklist.title: Job Queue Data Integrity on Processing

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-JOB-STARTS-PROCESSING reads job data from queue as stored without corruption.
steps: Review queue implementation in prover service
Verify job data is read exactly as stored
Check queue data structure integrity
Verify no data transformation between queue and processing
Test job processing maintains data fidelity

executable_checks.description: Test job data roundtrip through queue

checklist.notes: Queue integrity is service implementation concern - data should be read as stored

checklist.title: Nova to Groth16 Circuit Parameter Consistency

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-PROVER-CONVERTS uses consistent circuit parameters from trusted configuration.
steps: Locate circuit parameter loading in prover
Verify parameters are loaded from trusted configuration
Check same parameters used for all conversions
Verify no dynamic parameter modification
Test conversion produces verifiable Groth16 proof

checklist.notes: Circuit parameter consistency is critical for proof system security

checklist.title: Valid Groth16 Proof on Job Completion

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-JOB-COMPLETED stores only valid Groth16 proof after successful conversion.
steps: Review job completion logic in prover
Verify completion only on valid proof output
Check proof validation before storage
Verify no invalid proof can be marked completed
Test proof validity after retrieval

executable_checks.focus: All completed job proofs are valid

checklist.notes: Success path from conversion - only valid proofs should be marked complete

checklist.title: Correct Conversion Failure Reporting

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-JOB-FAILED correctly reports conversion failure without false positives.
steps: Review failure handling in prover service
Verify failure only on actual conversion error
Check no valid conversion incorrectly marked failed
Verify deterministic process prevents random failures
Test failure scenarios and error reporting

executable_checks.focus: Valid conversions never marked as failed

checklist.notes: Failure path from conversion - deterministic process prevents random failures

checklist.title: Root Reference Existence Validation

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF checks root exists in proved or global roots mapping.
steps: Locate root validation in Verifier teleport flow
Verify mapping lookup returns zero for non-existent keys
Check comparison logic rejects fabricated roots
Verify both local and global root mappings are checked
Test rejection of non-existent root references

executable_checks.description: Test rejection of fabricated root references

checklist.notes: First validation step - mapping lookup is deterministic for rejection

checklist.title: Recipient Hash Commitment Verification

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH computes recipient hash on-chain and compares with proof commitment.
steps: Locate recipient validation in Verifier
Verify hash is computed on-chain from claimed recipient
Check comparison with proof public input
Verify mismatch causes transaction revert
Test with mismatched recipients

executable_checks.description: Test rejection of mismatched recipient hashes

checklist.notes: Recipient integrity check - hash binding prevents funds going to wrong address

checklist.title: totalTeleported Strict Monotonicity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces strictly increasing totalTeleported to prevent replay attacks.
steps: Locate monotonicity check in Verifier
Verify strict inequality (>) comparison
Check stored totalTeleported is updated after verification
Verify replay with equal value causes revert
Test replay attack scenarios

executable_checks.focus: Same proof cannot be used twice

checklist.notes: CRITICAL: Double-spend prevention - replay has equal totalTeleported, guaranteed rejection

checklist.title: Groth16 Withdrawal Proof Verification

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF performs cryptographic Groth16 pairing check.
steps: Locate withdrawal proof verification in Verifier
Verify Groth16 pairing check is performed
Check verifying key matches deployed circuit
Verify invalid proofs fail with high probability
Test with invalid/malformed proofs

checklist.notes: Cryptographic core of teleport - Groth16 soundness provides ~2^128 security

checklist.title: Teleport Call After All Validations

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-PROOF-VALID-CALL-TELEPORT calls zERC20.teleport() only after all validations complete.
steps: Trace verification flow in Verifier
Verify all validations occur before teleport call
Check no path bypasses any validation step
Verify edge only exists from successful proof validation
Test validation failure prevents teleport call

executable_checks.focus: Control flow analysis of verification path

checklist.notes: Final validation before minting - all checks must pass before teleport call

checklist.title: Exact Delta Amount Minting to Verified Recipient

detection_procedure.description: Verify that EDGE-TELEPORT-MINTED mints exact delta amount to verified recipient from proof public inputs.
steps: Locate teleport function in zERC20
Verify amount and recipient extracted from verified proof
Check no user input affects final mint values
Verify delta calculation is correct
Test minting with various proof values

executable_checks.focus: Mint parameters from verified proof only

executable_checks.description: Test mint amount matches proof delta
executable_checks.focus: Minted amount exactly matches proof specification

checklist.notes: Minting with verified parameters - no user input affects final values
